title: armeria plantaginea subsp. castellana
intro: Armeria plantaginea subsp. castellana, commonly known as Castellana thyme or Castellana armeria, is a plant species within the Plumbaginaceae family. It is a flowering plant used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Armeria plantaginea subsp. castellana include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate conditions such as respiratory issues, wounds, and skin irritations. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic actions include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which may exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
